title: Cybersecurity Essentials for Working Professionals
shortDescription: Build practical, job-ready cybersecurity foundations in a part-time format.
description: A hands-on introduction to modern cybersecurity for working adults. Covers threat models, network defence, identity, and secure operations through applied labs and scenario-based assessments.
eligibility: Open to working adults; no prior security experience required.

title: Security Operations Centre Analyst
shortDescription: Advance into SOC analysis with detection engineering and triage practice.
description: Develop the skills of a modern SOC analyst: log analysis, detection rules, alert triage, and threat hunting using synthetic telemetry from a simulated enterprise.
eligibility: For learners with foundational security or IT operations experience.

title: Applied Artificial Intelligence Foundations
shortDescription: Understand and apply core AI techniques to real business problems.
description: A foundational programme covering machine learning concepts, model evaluation, and responsible AI, with applied projects using synthetic datasets.
eligibility: Open to all; basic numeracy recommended.

title: Generative AI Practitioner
shortDescription: Design and evaluate generative AI solutions responsibly.
description: An intermediate course on applying generative models to enterprise use cases, including prompt design, retrieval augmentation, evaluation, and governance.
eligibility: For learners familiar with basic AI or software concepts.

title: Diploma in Data Analytics
shortDescription: A structured pathway into analytics, from data wrangling to storytelling.
description: Comprehensive diploma covering data preparation, statistical analysis, visualisation, and communication, with a capstone using synthetic operational data.
eligibility: Open to recent graduates and career changers.

title: Data Visualisation and Storytelling
shortDescription: Turn data into clear, persuasive visual narratives.
description: A short course on designing effective dashboards and visual stories, focusing on clarity, accessibility, and audience-appropriate communication.
eligibility: For learners with basic data familiarity.

title: Cloud Computing Foundations
shortDescription: Get started with cloud concepts, services, and deployment models.
description: An introductory programme covering cloud service models, core infrastructure, cost awareness, and basic deployment using vendor-neutral concepts.
eligibility: Open to all; basic IT familiarity recommended.

title: Cloud Solutions Architecture
shortDescription: Design resilient, cost-aware cloud architectures.
description: An advanced part-time course on architecting scalable cloud solutions, covering reliability, security, and cost optimisation through applied design exercises.
eligibility: For learners with cloud fundamentals and some IT experience.

title: Full-Stack Web Development
shortDescription: Build modern web applications end to end.
description: A practical part-time programme on building full-stack web applications, covering front-end frameworks, APIs, and deployment through project work.
eligibility: For learners with basic programming familiarity.

title: Introduction to Programming
shortDescription: Learn to code from first principles.
description: A beginner short course introducing programming fundamentals, problem decomposition, and basic algorithms using an approachable language.
eligibility: Open to all; no prior experience required.

title: DevOps Practitioner
shortDescription: Automate delivery with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability.
description: An intermediate course on DevOps practices, covering pipelines, infrastructure as code, and monitoring through hands-on labs on synthetic systems.
eligibility: For learners with software or operations experience.

title: Site Reliability Engineering
shortDescription: Operate resilient systems at scale.
description: An advanced course on reliability engineering, covering service-level objectives, incident management, and capacity planning with applied scenarios.
eligibility: For experienced engineers or operations staff.

title: Leading Digital Transformation
shortDescription: Drive change with digital strategy and operating-model design.
description: A programme for managers on planning and leading digital transformation, covering strategy, change management, and value measurement.
eligibility: For professionals in leadership or project roles.

title: Product Management Essentials
shortDescription: Learn to discover, prioritise, and deliver valuable products.
description: A short course on core product management: discovery, prioritisation, roadmapping, and stakeholder communication, with applied exercises.
eligibility: Open to all professionals.

title: Business Analytics for Decision-Making
shortDescription: Use data to inform business decisions with confidence.
description: An intermediate part-time course connecting analytics to business decisions, covering metrics, experimentation, and communicating insight to stakeholders.
eligibility: For professionals who work with data or reporting.

title: Internet of Things Engineering
shortDescription: Design and connect smart devices and sensor systems.
description: An intermediate course on IoT engineering, covering embedded basics, connectivity, and data pipelines using synthetic sensor scenarios.
eligibility: For learners with basic electronics or programming interest.

title: Robotics and Automation
shortDescription: Explore automation systems and robotic control.
description: An advanced course on robotics and automation covering control concepts, motion, and safety, with applied simulation exercises.
eligibility: For learners with engineering fundamentals.

title: UX Design Fundamentals
shortDescription: Design usable, accessible digital experiences.
description: A beginner course on user experience design, covering research, wireframing, prototyping, and accessibility through practical exercises.
eligibility: Open to all; no design background required.

title: Advanced Product Design
shortDescription: Lead end-to-end product design with systems thinking.
description: An advanced course on product design covering design systems, interaction patterns, and design leadership through a portfolio project.
eligibility: For learners with UX or design experience.

title: Health Informatics Essentials
shortDescription: Apply data and digital tools in healthcare settings.
description: An intermediate course on health informatics covering health data standards, privacy, and digital workflows using synthetic clinical scenarios.
eligibility: For healthcare or administrative professionals.

title: Digital Health Innovation
shortDescription: Design digital solutions for better care outcomes.
description: An advanced course on digital health innovation covering service design, evaluation, and adoption using synthetic case studies.
eligibility: For healthcare professionals or innovators.

title: Hospitality Operations Management
shortDescription: Run efficient, guest-focused hospitality operations.
description: A course on hospitality operations covering service quality, resource planning, and guest experience through applied case studies.
eligibility: Open to those entering or working in hospitality.

title: Digital Marketing for Hospitality
shortDescription: Attract and retain guests with digital marketing.
description: An intermediate course on digital marketing tailored to hospitality, covering channels, content, and measurement with applied projects.
eligibility: For hospitality or marketing staff.

title: Data Engineering Fundamentals
shortDescription: Build reliable data pipelines and models.
description: An intermediate course on data engineering covering pipelines, storage, and modelling with hands-on labs using synthetic datasets.
eligibility: For learners with basic programming familiarity.

title: Zero Trust Security Architecture
shortDescription: Design identity-centric, zero trust security models.
description: An advanced course on zero trust architecture covering identity, segmentation, and policy enforcement through applied design work.
eligibility: For learners with security fundamentals.

title: MLOps Foundations
shortDescription: Operationalise machine learning models reliably.
description: A forthcoming course on MLOps covering model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management. Content is being finalised.
eligibility: For learners with applied AI experience.

title: Foundations of On-Premise Networking
shortDescription: A retired introduction to traditional networking.
description: An archived course covering traditional on-premise networking concepts. Retained for reference; no longer offered.
eligibility: No longer offered.
